target_customer: Developers and startups building AI agents that need company context and memory
problem: AI agents lack knowledge of how a company works. Hyperspell connects tools such as Slack, Gmail and Notion into a permissioned context graph that agents can read and write.
product_category: Context and memory layer for AI agents

founders.name: Conor Brennan-Burke
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: led a $30M ARR API business at Checkr.

founders.name: Manu Ebert
previous_startups: ML/AI startup acquired by Airbnb (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: 4x founder with 2 exits, built Airbnb's first knowledge graph.

competitors.name: Mem0
competitors.traction_then: AWS Strands exclusive memory provider selected May 2025
competitors.funding_then: $24M across seed and Series A announced 2025-10

competitors.name: Zep
competitors.what: Memory and temporal knowledge graph for agents

technical_complexity.rationale: Many connectors, permission-aware indexing and a knowledge graph with fact-level provenance; standard but broad engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Connectors and accumulated graph add friction, but memory is a crowded space and platforms can add native memory.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Several funded memory startups and model providers built memory features in 2025; no acquisition found.

market_need_then: Agent builders in 2025 repeatedly hit the problem of agents having no persistent or company-specific context, driving funding into memory startups.

identity.voice_and_tone: confident and playful: 'Your AI agent is a clueless genius'

branding.brand_signature: the corgi illustration and the company brain pitch

brand_strength.rationale: Some personality (corgi, copy) but little press on the brand.

pivots.why: Aggregator profile says the founders pivoted from Echo AI; timing and reason not sourced.

outcome_analysis: Hyperspell is an active Fall 2025 company with two experienced founders, one with prior exits, in the hot agent memory category. Verified funding is absent, so its trajectory is unknown. Heavily funded rivals like Mem0 are the main competitive pressure.
